errors.text: The proposed phase-selective recrystallization is not the target HPHT treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
No processing parameters are given for phase-selective recrystallization; the listed conditions describe only mechanical testing.
The mechanism conflates evidence from different alloy systems and does not demonstrate dislocation transfer across coherent FCC/B2 interfaces or relief of boundary pile-ups.
The falsification experiment tests only final tensile properties and cannot distinguish the proposed interfacial mechanism from alternative strengthening and ductilization mechanisms.
